name: Copilot Cowork
desc: Microsoft 365 Copilot mode that returns finished deliverables
desc_zh: Microsoft 365 Copilot 里直接交付成品的模式
solves: Copilot Cowork runs long multi-tool jobs to completion and returns results, not drafts.
solves_zh: Copilot Cowork 把多工具的长任务整个跑完，交回来的是结果，不是草稿。
best_for: When the deliverable is the point — a flow chart, a ranked list, a finished draft.
best_for_zh: 当要的本身就是那份成品——流程图、排好序的清单、写完的稿子。
notes: Generally available worldwide and grounded in Microsoft Graph, so it competes directly with Muse and Grok Bot on office work. 来源：https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/blog/2026/06/16/copilot-cowork-is-now-generally-available
